title: The app catalog gets better signposts
summary:
A busy day in the app garden: clearer catalog badges, a restored apps page, and a lot more community-built things to explore.

The apps page added Fresh, Pollen, and Buzz badges for recently approved apps, apps with Pollinations sign-in, and apps with at least 100 API requests in 24 hours. Category filters now persist in the URL, and a separate fix restored the catalog after its app-list source returned a 404.

Community additions span illustrated storybooks, presentations, image editing, personas, storyboards, live-coded music, stickers, and filmmaking with scene memory. Two larger batches also brought image generators, a jigsaw puzzle maker, and other creative tools into the catalog.

The catalog also gained apps for focus wallpapers, branching chat, quizzes, citations, model benchmarking, guided journaling, and a Telegram assistant. Developer additions include an OpenCode plugin and an interface for running local models.

daily.title: Find your kind of app
daily.text: Browse apps by category and spot new arrivals with Fresh badges, Pollinations sign-in with Pollen badges, and recent activity with Buzz badges. Filters stay in the URL, so you can share what you found. [Explore community apps](https://pollinations.ai).
